WITH totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(articount) as total_artifacts
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE articount IS NOT NULL
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.zoneref,
    sf.articount,
    CAST(sf.articount AS FLOAT) / t.total_artifacts as share
  FROM scanfeatures sf
  CROSS JOIN totals t
  WHERE sf.articount IS NOT NULL
    AND t.total_artifacts IS NOT NULL
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM with_share
)
SELECT 
  ws.zoneref,
  ws.articount,
  ws.share,
  ws.share - avgs.avg_share as diff
FROM with_share ws
CROSS JOIN avg_share avgs
WHERE avgs.avg_share IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  ws.share - avgs.avg_share DESC
LIMIT 10
